title: Expressive Asset
description: Metadata contract for a single asset in the Expressive Assets library. Mirrors the property set used by the Figma library (Type, Family, Status, Build, Size, Theme) so exports map 1:1.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier. Format: <category>.<slug>. Never change this once published - downstream code references it.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the browser UI.

category.description: Sub-collection within the type. Icons: system | product | file. Illustrations: windows | fluent | product.

family.description: Design family the asset belongs to. Drives which review board owns it.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'active' is safe to ship; 'inactive' is retired but kept for back-compat; 'na' is unclassified.

build.description: Release channel the asset is approved for. Consumers on stable must not pick up alpha assets.

themes.description: Rendered theme variants that exist on disk. color = Expressive, regular = Outline, filled = Mono.

sizes.description: Pixel sizes the artwork is designed to read correctly at. The SVG is scalable, but below the smallest listed size the geometry is not legible.

colors.description: Brand colors baked into the color (Expressive) variant.

tags.description: Search keywords. Include synonyms a designer might type instead of the asset name.

variants.description: Site-root-relative path to each theme's SVG. Keys must match the themes array.

version.description: Semver for the artwork itself. Bump minor for a redraw, major for a shape change that breaks visual continuity.

updated.description: ISO date of the last artwork change.

owner.description: GitHub handle or team responsible for this asset.

figmaNodeId.description: Node ID in the source Figma library, so the artwork can be traced back upstream.

deprecatedBy.description: Asset id that replaces this one. Required reading when build is 'deprecated'.

notes.description: Usage guidance, restrictions, or redraw history.
